label: Double Waistband
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Sharp 1418x1200 product photograph of high-rise grey flannel trousers, front-left quarter, cropped waist to upper thigh. The waistband is unmistakably built in TWO STACKED TIERS: an upper band whose left extension tab carries 2 vertically stacked buttons, and a second band tier stepped beneath it running off to the right, which has its own pointed extension tab and a 3rd button. Scaling off the buttons (approx 1.7 cm) the combined band height is roughly 9 cm - about double a normal waistband, exactly the 'cummerbund built into the trousers' effect described. One belt loop crosses both tiers; 1 forward pleat and a curved side pocket are also visible.
